lifecycle: Different human IDs remain distinct even when display names or colors collide.
Each same-human logical tab remains live; only repeated Awareness epochs for the exact human/device/client/room identity collapse.
A reload retains the tab's logical client ID and advances its connection epoch; a Duplicate Tab/window.open sessionStorage clone regenerates its copied client ID before publication.
Cooperative close and hard transport loss remove only the owning connection's Awareness client within a bounded interval.
Reconnect supersedes the prior exact-session epoch without evicting another legitimate same-human tab or accumulating raw ghosts.
Document switch, graph switch, and rapid reload clean the source room while preserving target-room truth.
interaction: Avatar hover and click expose actor identity plus same-human tab/device grouping without pretending grouped tabs are one cursor.
Human versus Agent is explicit; self name/color controls exist only for the actual local human and cannot mutate account identity or actor type.
Self display-name and cursor-color edits update real Awareness state and are reused by that human in the browser.
Follow targets one cursor-bearing logical client ID, never a display-name/color guess, and stops cleanly.
The visible avatar stack is bounded while +N overflow retains an inspector path for every additional actor.
Remote cursor and label DOM are contenteditable=false so cursor decorations are opaque to mobile/Gecko editing and IME behavior.
